title: Change disposal hold
purpose: Place or remove an explicit physical disposal hold without changing the sample’s receipt decision or custody location.
summary: Place or remove a hold that stops physical disposal of this sample. The receipt decision and location are not changed.

tasks.title: Hold a sample from disposal
steps: Choose Place hold in [[Disposal hold]], give the [[Reason]] and select [[Change disposal hold]].

tasks.title: Remove the hold
steps: Choose Remove hold, give the [[Reason]] and select [[Change disposal hold]].

good_to_know: Removing the hold never disposes of the sample.
This hold is separate from a receipt Hold disposition. Clearing one does not clear the other.
A hold can be placed before a retention date is set.

items.label: Disposal hold
items.description: Required Place hold or Remove hold. Starts with Place hold when no hold exists, and Remove hold when one exists. Choose a different state; unchanged submissions are refused. A hold can be placed before a retention date is set.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation recorded with previous/new state and actor.

items.label: Change disposal hold
items.description: Saves and returns to storage. Removing this hold does not clear receipt disposition Hold and never triggers disposal.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the storage record without saving.

sections.title: Access and safeguards
paragraphs: Custodians, project managers and administrators can save. The header names the client and current location. A concurrent custody, retention or sample change is refused; submitted input remains on the error page. Reload and review current custody/retention before resubmitting. A disposed sample shows a retained-history notice instead of an editable form and rejects further changes.
